updates.content:
Title: Users may be unable to load SharePoint Online sites or pages and receive an error message

User impact: Users may be unable to load SharePoint Online sites or pages and receive an error message.

More info: The error message states: "Sorry, something went wrong: Thread was being aborted."

Current status: We're investigating a potential issue with SharePoint Online and checking for impact to your organization. We'll provide an update within 30 minutes.

Title: Users may be unable to load SharePoint Online sites or pages and receive an error message

User impact: Users may be unable to load SharePoint Online sites or pages and receive an error message.

More info: The error message states: "Sorry, something went wrong: Thread was being aborted."

Current status: We've identified a recent configuration change concerning how the server delivers code to site pages to render as content resulted in impact. We're rolling back this change to remediate the issue for all users.

Scope of impact: This issue may affect any user attempting to load SharePoint Online sites and pages.

Start time: Tuesday, August 25, 2026, at 3:45 PM UTC

Root cause: A recent configuration change concerning how the server delivers code to site pages to render as content resulted in impact.

Next update by: Wednesday, September 16, 2026, at 4:30 PM UTC

Title: Users may be unable to load SharePoint Online sites or pages and receive an error message

User impact: Users may have been unable to load SharePoint Online sites or pages and receive an error message.

More info: The error message stated: "Sorry, something went wrong: Thread was being aborted."
 
Final status: We reverted the change and confirmed through our service telemetry that impact is resolved. 
 
Scope of impact: This issue may have affected any user attempting to load SharePoint Online sites and pages.
 
Start time: Tuesday, August 25, 2026, at 3:45 PM UTC
 
End time: Wednesday, September 16, 2026, at 3:17 PM UTC
 
Preliminary root cause: A recent configuration change concerning how the server delivers code to site pages to render as content resulted in impact.
 
Next steps: 
-We're further assessing the process by which we validate and deploy configuration changes to ensure future rollouts don't result in similar impact. 
 
We'll provide a preliminary Post-Incident Report within two business days and a final Post-Incident Report within five business days.
